title: Restyle Video: Wan VACE
description: A video given a new look: the motion and camera of your video are kept, the look comes from a reference picture and the prompt (Wan VACE).

labels.900:value: Describe the new look (the motion comes from the video)
labels.902:value: Length in frames (4n+1; 81 is 3.4 s at 24 fps)
labels.299:file: Source video (its motion and camera are kept)
labels.73:image: Style frame or reference (the new look)

hints: The reference sets the look: a restyled first frame of the video, or a picture of the style you want.
The length is in frames: 4n+1, such as 49, 81 or 121.
